S2 token talent range selection is bridged by applyTalentRange1, remote sktok x-2 and selected talent_range_flag1; native mode/remote blackboard dispatcher is unrecovered. The reviewed detection grid is separate from original normal attacking range.

Reveal immunity9 is mapped to Invisible immunity/reveal as in original description; purpose0 aura does not borrow attack-specific Invisible/Sleep rejection. Exact numeric validator/body-edge membership and flag dispatcher are unrecovered.

Native RechargeToken NORMAL/max-deck caps and stock persistence across owner removal are source-field interpretations. Fresh owner born stock3/4/5 and own token card ten-second placement clock are tested; no additive removal recharge is fabricated.

Source Skill_1 begin animation presents an immediate token mode change, with no ability predelay/Attack-event dependency serialized. Native normal attack reentry/clip blending during this presentation remains unrecovered.
Original Unity particle/audio identifiers are retained but their effects are unsupported; no replacement skill effects are fabricated.

Native remote skill canUseInAbnormalState0 is represented by living/non-hidden, canAct and no-disarm end-command eligibility; canSilenced0 never adds a silence gate. Exact prolonged Stun clip looping/pose and status/abnormal remote-command dispatcher remain unrecovered.

Camera five-second Stun is enforced by the combat engine. The regular renderer currently has no general controlled-state animation driver; its original one-shot Stun clip is retained/bound but is not claimed to play during that entire status. No broader renderer behavior is introduced by this kit.
